{{Quote|I'll tell you what: I usually only offer new members a quarter-share of the booty until they've proven themselves. For you I'll make an exception. You join and I'll give you a triple share of anything we grab as partners. That's more than fair&hellip; and probably a good deal more than you're getting now. Deal?|[[Safonne Pendon]], to [[Denuab Venithon|Denuab]] and [[Dorin Venithon]]|<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>}}
[[Safonne Pendon]] commanded a '''pirate''' band that operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Pendon commanded a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] including two heavily-modified [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]], a pair of [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 frigates]], a [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat]], and his command ship, the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Safonne's Sword]]''. He commanded over two hundred parents of varying [[Species/Legends|species]], including the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Venithon Twins]]. Pendon's base was located in the northern polar region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seltaya Major]] in the [[Mieru'kar sector/Legends|Mieru'kar sector]].

In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], Pendon's pirates began attacking [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] ships, effectively stopping resupply efforts in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]].
